note: The PUBLIC half, committed in exactly ONE place. The deterministic bundle carries only this key digest and the profile id; the envelope carries the key itself. Three copies of a public key is three chances to disagree.

rotation.policy: a rotation is a signed object of schema simurgh.vsr.q0.key-rotation.v1, signed by the OUTGOING key. A rotation signed by the incoming key would let anyone holding any key declare themselves the successor.
rotation.chain_note: EMPTY, and empty means no rotation has happened — which is the honest state. Manufacturing a rotation event so the chain looked longer would be fabricating history in a stage about fabricated execution reality. verifyRotationChain accepts an empty chain only when the presented key IS the genesis key.
